documents.extraction_hint: Extract key topics, conclusions, entities, and relationships from this document.

people.description: Information about people — bios, profiles, contacts, org charts
people.extraction_hint: Focus on extracting people (names, roles, organizations), their skills, relationships to other people, and affiliations.

projects.description: Project documentation, specs, plans, roadmaps, requirements
projects.extraction_hint: Extract project names, goals, technologies used, team members involved, dependencies, milestones, and relationships between project components.

knowledge.description: Learning material — articles, papers, tutorials, notes, books
knowledge.extraction_hint: Extract core concepts, theories, definitions, and their relationships. Focus on building a conceptual hierarchy (is_a, part_of, depends_on).

code.description: Source code, scripts, configurations, architecture docs
code.extraction_hint: Extract technologies, libraries, design patterns, APIs, modules, and their relationships (depends_on, part_of, used_for).

media.extraction_hint: Describe what you see in detail. Extract all visible concepts, labels, entities, and their spatial or logical relationships.

conversations.description: Chat logs, meeting transcripts, interview notes, conversation exports
conversations.extraction_hint: Extract the participants (as person nodes), topics discussed, decisions made, action items, and relationships between people and topics. Identify who said what about which topic.

data.description: Structured data — CSVs, JSONs, spreadsheets, datasets
data.extraction_hint: Extract the schema/structure, key entities, categories, and patterns in the data. Identify relationships between data fields and real-world concepts.

root_files_hint: General content without specific categorization. Extract all meaningful concepts and relationships.
